items.title: 33.8 Rules and Regulations regarding Waste Pollution and Conservation

source_refs.note: Topic 33.8, printed page 256 (PDF 259), with Table 33.3 and the Did You Know box. Laws and penalties are carried as printed, not checked against current statutes. Exercises (PDF 260-261) excluded.

blocks.text: The Government of Punjab has made several acts and laws to address the water pollution within its jurisdiction. The Punjab Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab regularly issues relevant rules and regulations for all concerned stakeholders. Below is a comprehensive overview of the key self-explanatory rules and regulations issued by EPA Punjab (Pakistan) related to water pollution control and conservation.

blocks.caption: Table 33.3 Key environmental regulations and conservation measures
rows: Fines up to Rs 5 million, plus additional daily fines of up to Rs 100,000.
Prohibits discharging pollutants or blocking flow.
Up to 3 months imprisonment and/or a Rs 500,000 fine.
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Sets water usage and drainage fees, regulates discharge permits to prevent industrial/agricultural pollution.
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Establishes the Authority in major cities (Lahore, Multan, etc.) for integrated resource management and groundwater conservation.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: The penalty for the use of hosepipes for car-washing and flood irrigation in domestic lawns or gardens is a Fine of Rs 10,000 under the Pakistan Penal Code.
